answer: The ledger lets only accounts aged 40+ epochs sponsor, two newcomers per epoch, each backed by a 100-credit bond. Bonds sit in a velvet lock until the newcomer survives 40 epochs unchallenged. Ages come from the tundra log, an append-only record of each key's first epoch that cannot be reset or bought. A proven clone slashes every bond up to its subtree's summit, so the 30th fake exposes 3,000 credits, and the farm grows only by waiting epochs, not by parallel spending.
